items.title: Does Motorola (MSI) Have the Potential to Rally 25.35% as Wall Street Analysts Expect?
items.summary: The average of price targets set by Wall Street analysts indicates a potential upside of 25.4% in Motorola (MSI). While the effectiveness of this highly sought-after metric is questionable, the positive trend in earnings estimate revisions might translate into an upside in the stock.

items.title: Is Ondas in Play? Potential Acquirers Eye This Autonomous-Defense Specialist.
items.summary: Ondas has quietly assembled a counter-drone, loitering munitions, and agentic-AI portfolio that looks more like a prime contractor's missing puzzle piece than a standalone small-cap. Four defense giants are sizing it up, and the ranking of who fits best may surprise you.

items.title: Can Motorola (MSI) Keep the Earnings Surprise Streak Alive?
items.summary: Motorola (MSI) has an impressive earnings surprise history and currently possesses the right combination of the two key ingredients for a likely beat in its next quarterly report.

items.title: Motorola Solutions Earnings Preview: What to Expect
items.summary: Motorola Solutions is expected to announce its second-quarter results soon, and analysts predict a single-digit rise in the company’s bottom-line figure.

items.title: 2 Services Stocks Worth Your Attention and 1 Facing Challenges
items.summary: Business services providers use their specialized expertise to help enterprises streamline operations and cut costs. Still, investors are uneasy as firms face challenges from AI-driven disruptors and tightening corporate budgets. These doubts have certainly contributed to services stocks’ recent underperformance - over the past six months, the industry’s 8% gain has fallen behind the S&P 500’s 10.8% rise.

items.title: Axon Extends Win Streak On Target Hike, World Cup Drone Defense
items.summary: Axon Enterprise — the maker of Tasers, body cameras and software for law enforcement — continued its resurgence on the stock market Monday.  Needham hiked its Axon stock price target to 750 from 600, keeping a buy rating, according to The Fly investment news site.  Axon Enterprise cited an expansion of the Los Angeles Police Department pact with Axon, which will more than double annual spending to $22 million.
